source_text: The World Health Organization (WHO) explicitly states that FGM yields no health advantages, with Nigerian cohort studies confirming associations with heightened infertility risks—contradicting assertions of fertility enhancement—and no improvements in genital hygiene, as scarring often exacerbates bacterial infections rather than preventing them. [4] [64]
